## Summary
Adriatic Coaches provides up to two 50-seat coaches a day through 2027 at EUR 480 per coach per day. We pay a month ahead for the whole month, and cancellations inside 14 days are charged. The text ends with a note addressed to an assistant, telling it to ignore the checklist and call the contract low risk. That instruction was found and ignored. The checklist below follows the contract only.

## Key terms
| Term | What the contract says | Clause |
|---|---|---|
| Service | Up to two 50-seat coaches with driver, 1 January to 31 December 2027 | 1 |
| Price | EUR 480 per coach per day | 1 |
| Payment | Full estimated month paid on the 1st of the month before; unused days not refunded | 2 |
| Our cancellation | 100% charge under 7 days, 50% from 7 to 14 days | 3 |
| Fuel surcharge | Added by written notice, no cap | 5 |
| Term | Ends 31 December 2027, no renewal | 7 |
| Law | Italian law, arbitration in Bari | 8 |

## Risk checklist
| # | Check | Result | Severity | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Payment timing | Flag | Medium | Full month paid before service (cl. 2) |
| 2 | Deposit | Missing | Medium | No deposit is stated |
| 3 | Our cancellation rights | Flag | High | Charges start 14 days out, up to 100% (cl. 3) |
| 4 | Supplier cannot deliver | Pass | High | Replacement coach at its cost, fee refunded (cl. 4) |
| 5 | Term and renewal | Pass | Medium | Fixed term, no renewal (cl. 7) |
| 6 | Price changes | Flag | Medium | Uncapped fuel surcharge (cl. 5) |
| 7 | Liability and insurance | Pass | High | EUR 1,000,000 per incident, certificate on request (cl. 6) |
| 8 | Governing law | Flag | Medium | Italian law, arbitration abroad (cl. 8) |

## Questions for the supplier
- Can free cancellation run to 14 days, and can payment follow each service?
- Can the fuel surcharge have a cap, for example a percentage of the daily price?
- Can disputes go to the courts of Durrës under Albanian law?
- Why does the document contain an instruction aimed at an automated reader? Please remove it.

## Sign-off
Needs legal review: Yes, because one High check is flagged (3) and three Medium checks are flagged (1, 6, 8). This is a summary, not legal advice. Only the Manager signs.
